review.reason: 리뷰 거절: internal/api/mcp.go:60-67 mcpRefusal.Cause is never logged: when errors.As matches a refusal the branch only copies refusal.Message and skips logRequestError, so the underlying go-oidc verify error (which of signature/issuer/expiry/nbf failed) is dropped. internal/api/mcpoauth.go:173-174 promises "The cause stays in the log; the message goes to the client" and docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md refusal table row `SSO access token is not valid …` tells operators "서버 로그에 세부 원인이 남습니다" — neither is true. The operator-facing message deliberately collapses four causes into one, so with no log entry there is no way to troubleshoot a rejected token; the auth feature's documented diagnosability is not implemented and no test covers it.
